notes: Printed: 'At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, this creature gets +2/+2 and gains trample until end of turn.' I sacrifice Fodder: the Warmonger is 5/5 trample, a 3/3 blocks it, 3 lethal to the blocker and 2 trample over (opponent 20 -> 18). At end of turn the +2/+2 and trample end and its 3 damage wears off at the same time (CR 514.2): it is a 3/3 with no trample and survives.
